l: ――気がついたか  カンタン
...You're awake, Quinten.
Welcome back to the land of the living.
-- kiga tsuitaka kantan
ロストウィングは  どうなった…
What became of Lostwing...?
Is Lostwing...?
rosutouingu ha dounatta…
エーテル溜まりに沈んだ
It sank into the aetherflood.
The flood has filled the valley...
eeteru tama rini shizun da
そうか…
I see...
I see...
souka…
これで正真正銘  空っぽってわけだな…
So now I'm truly empty, huh...?
Then all is at an end...
korede shoushinshoumei karappo ttewakedana…
やっとのことで果たした復讐も  虚しいだけだったよ
Even the revenge I spent years achieving was nothing but hollow.
A strange way to achieve one's life's ambition...
yattonokotode hata shita fukushuu mo munashii dakedattayo
マスター  安静にしていないと！
Master, you need to rest!
No, Master Quinten! Save your strength.
masutaa ansei nishiteinaito!
…大丈夫だ
...I'm fine.
Why?
… daijoubu da
何年もかけて築いた村も  一瞬で消えちまった
A village I spent years building, gone in an instant.
All that I strove for is gone... Only emptiness remains...
nannen mokakete kizui ta mura mo isshun de kie chimatta
俺は――
ore haaa
俺は何で  まだ生きてやがる…
Why am I still alive...?
I have nothing left to live for...
ore ha nande mada iki teyagaru…
何てことを言うんだ！
What are you saying!?
What the heck are you on about?
nante kotowo iu nda!

俺たちを“人”として扱ってくれて
生きる場所を与えてくれた あんたが…！
You treated us as human and gave us a place to live...!

You've got us, ain't you? Don't try telling me you only freed us so you could get revenge?
We're more than that to you, and we all know it!
ore tachiwo “ nin ” toshite atsukatsu tekurete / iki ru basho wo atae tekureta antaga…!
僕…マスターには  もう会えないと思ってたんだ…
I... I thought I'd never see Master again...
I...I thought you weren't coming back.
boku… masutaa niha mou ae naito omotte tanda…

マスターの“用事”のことは よく知らなかったけど…
きっと それが終わったら帰ってこないんだって…
I didn't really know about Master's "errand," but... I was sure you wouldn't come back when it was over...
But I prayed and I prayed and you did! There's got to be a reason for that, right?
masutaa no “ youji ” nokotoha yoku shira nakattakedo… / kitto sorega owa ttara kaetsu tekonaindatte…

でも マスターは帰ってきてくれた
これからも 僕たちのマスターだよね…？

But Master came back.
You'll still be our Master from now on, won't you...?
Can't we just go back to how it was? You know, you looking after us all?
demo masutaa ha kaetsu tekitekureta / korekaramo boku tachino masutaa dayone…？
やっぱり  あんたは生きなきゃいけない
You have to live, after all.
Your work ain't over yet, Master Quinten.
yappari antaha iki nakyaikenai

俺たちを生かしておいて
自分だけ死ぬなんて許さないからな…！
We won't let you keep us alive and go dying on your own...!
We believed that you were the right man to lead us...and we still do.
ore tachiwo ika shiteoite / jibun dake shinu nante yurusa naikarana…!
助かった村人は  みんなここにいる
The villagers who were saved are all here.
Your village may be lost, but it seems your people aren't.
tasuka tta murabito ha minnakokoniiru
あんたが目覚めるのを  ずっと待っていた
They've been waiting for you to wake up.
So long as you remain to guide them.
antaga mezame runowo zutto matsu teita
…酔狂な奴らめ
...Such eccentric fools.
But why...? After what I've—
… suikyou na yatsu rame
何の得があって俺なんかを…
What do you have to gain from someone like me...?
Why would anyone follow me...?
nanno e gaatte ore nankawo…
だってマスター  僕たちは“家族”でしょ？
Because, Master, aren't we family?
'Cause we're family, aren't we?
datte masutaa boku tachiha “ kazoku ” desho？
家族…？
Family...?
Family...?
kazoku…？
死んでいった同志たちも  きっとそう思ってた
The comrades who died must have thought so, too.
Yeah. And all our comrades who went with you, they felt the same.
shin deitta doushi tachimo kittosou omotte ta
村で一緒に暮らしてたみんなは家族だって
That everyone living together in the village was family.
Lostwing weren't just a village. It was all of us.
mura de isshoni kurashi tetaminnaha kazoku datte

ロストウィングが何だってんだ！
マスター！　もう一度 村をつくろう！

What does Lostwing matter!
Master! Let's build a village again!
It was! And as long as we're still here, it is, too!
rosutouingu ga nanda ttenda! / masutaa! mou ichido mura wotsukurou!

このブドウ畑には まだ生きてる房もある！
私たちはやり直せるんだ もう一度！

There are still living vines in this vineyard!
We can start over, once more!
We can start again! Build a new Lostwing, right here in the Bales!
kono budou hatake niha mada iki teru bou moaru! / watashitachi hayari naose runda mou ichido!
…もう一度  か
...Once more, huh.
A fresh start...
… mou ichido ka
そうだな  悪くねえ提案だ
Yeah, that's not a bad proposal.
One life ends, and another begins...
soudana waruku nee teian da
村のひとつやふたつ  立て直してやろうじゃねえか
Let's rebuild a village or two.
Why just a village? We could build towns... A nation, even...
mura nohitotsuyafutatsu tatenaoshi teyaroujaneeka
…みんなでな
...Together.
What's to stop us!?
… minnadena
さすが  マスターだ！
That's our Master for you!
That's the Master Quinten we know!
sasuga masutaa da!
…お前ら  マスターはもうやめろ
...You lot, stop calling me Master.
Please—I am nobody's master.
… o mae ra masutaa hamouyamero
これからは  カンタンでいい
Just Quinten from now on.
"Quinten" will suffice.
korekaraha kantan deii
家族なんだから
Since we're family.
After all, we are family.
kazoku nandakara
すまんな  クライヴ
Sorry, Clive.
Permit me to withdraw my request.
sumanna kuraivu
家族は  俺が養っていく
I'll be the one to provide for my family.
I will no longer be needing your help in looking after my people.
kazoku ha ore ga yashinatsu teiku
お前の頼みは  聞かなかったことにしておくよ
I'll pretend I didn't hear that request.
I'll pretend you never asked.
o mae no tanomi ha kika nakattakotonishiteokuyo

…結局 お前には
最後まで世話になりっぱなしだったな
...In the end, I was looked after by you right to the very last, weren't I?

But you must be rewarded for your efforts on our behalf. You saved my life twice over.
And more besides.
… kekkyoku o mae niha / saigo made sewa ninarippanashidattana
礼なら  美味いワインで十分さ
As for thanks, good wine will do.
A bottle or two of your finest red will suffice.
rei nara umai wain de juubun sa
分かった  少し待ってろ
Understood. Wait here a moment.
Of course. Nothing but the best.
waka tta sukoshi matsu tero

この村を立て直したら
お前が飲んだこともない 上等なやつをこしらえてやる

Once I rebuild this village,
I'll brew a fine one unlike anything you've ever tasted.
And I have a feeling that this year's vintage will be the finest yet.
kono mura wo tatenaoshi tara / o mae ga non dakotomonai joutou nayatsuwokoshiraeteyaru
そのときは  いくらでも持っていけ
When that time comes, take as much of it as you like.
If you don't mind waiting, that is.
sonotokiha ikurademo motsu teike
楽しみにしてるよ
I'll look forward to it.
I look forward to it.
tanoshimi nishiteruyo
ああクライヴ  一体どうしたら…
Ah, Clive... What are we going to do...
Oh, Clive...what am I to do?
aa kuraivu ittai doushitara…
ノースリーチが分裂してしまうかもしれない…
Northreach might tear itself apart...
My wards and I may soon be without a home.
noosuriichi ga bunretsu shiteshimaukamoshirenai…
何があったんだ？
What happened?
What's happened?
nani gaattanda？
…実は先日  この街に《首の賢人》が戻ってきたわ
...Actually, the Sage of the Neck returned to the city the other day.

The High Cardinal has descended from his lofty throne and
taken up residence here in Northreach.
… jitsuha senjitsu kono machi ni << kubi no kenjin >> ga modotsu tekitawa
首の賢人…？
The Sage of the Neck...?
The High Cardinal?
kubi no kenjin…？

ええ ザンブレクの政を取り仕切る
《五賢人》の長だった人よ

Yes. He was the head of the Five Sages,
who direct the politics of Sanbreque.

Leader of the Council of Elders, second only to His Radiance
at the head of the imperial government.
ee zanbureku no matsurigoto wo tori shikiru / << goken nin >> no chou datta nin yo

その名のとおり 首都の施政を任されていたから
みんな今も“オリフレム公”って呼んでいるけど

True to his title, he was entrusted with governing the capital,
so everyone still calls him the Duke of Oriflamme.
Not that any of those things still exist. Now he goes by his noble title—the Duke of Oriflamme.
sono mei notoori shuto no shisei wo makasa reteitakara / minna ima mo “ orifuremu kou ” tte yon deirukedo
その彼がどうかしたのか？
What about him?
And what does he want with Northreach?
sono kare gadoukashitanoka？
オリフレム公が  お触れを出したの
The Duke of Oriflamme has issued a proclamation.
He wants to transform it into a military stronghold.
orifuremu kou ga o fure wo dashi tano
このノースリーチを  ザンブレクの新たな拠点にするって
That Northreach is to become Sanbreque's new stronghold.
A foundation upon which to build a "new" Sanbreque.
kono noosuriichi wo zanbureku no arata na kyoten nisurutte

彼は 街の住民から財産を徴収――
それを礎に ここを軍の中枢にしようとしている

He's seizing property from the townspeople...
and using that foundation to turn this place into a military hub.

<scale=0.94>He's already secured the support of the various army remnants, with promises that they shall be afforded the respect they deserve in his empire—one built on the confiscated property of the people.<scale>
kareha machi no juumin kara zaisan wo choushuuuu / sorewo ishizue ni kokowo gun no chuusuu nishiyoutoshiteiru
…何だって？
...What?
He would rob the populace to pay for it?
… nanda tte？

私たちが話しに行っても まともに取り合ってもらえない…
あんな無茶な要求 住民を追い出したがってるとしか…

Even when we go to talk to them, they won't give us the time of day...
Such an outrageous demand... it's like they're trying to drive out the residents...

Believe me, I have used every means of persuasion to discourage him from this folly.
But for whatever reason, he will not listen to me.
watashitachi ga hanashi ni itte mo matomoni tori atsu temoraenai… / anna mucha na youkyuu juumin wo oidashi tagatterutoshika…
兵士たちはどうなんだ？
What about the soldiers?
What does Captain Philippe make of this?
heishi tachihadounanda？

以前 青く光る魔物が現れたときは
フィリップが上手くまとめてくれていただろう？

Before, when that glowing blue monster appeared,
Philippe managed to keep them all in line, didn't he?

When the town was under attack, it was him the soldiers rallied around.
Couldn't he use that influence again?
izen aoku hikaru mamono ga araware tatokiha / firippu ga umaku matometekureteitadarou？
オリフレム公についているようね
It seems they're siding with the Duke of Oriflamme.
How? By speaking out against one of the most powerful men in Sanbreque?
orifuremu kou nitsuiteiruyoune

元々 軍の上層部を失っていた彼らが
指導者に従うのは理解できる

It's understandable that they'd follow a leader,
having lost their upper military command to begin with.

A man whose stated aim is to revive the empire Philippe's comrades swore to serve,
and to improve the soldier's lot within it?
motomoto gun no jousoubu wo utsu teita karera ga / shidousha ni shitagau noha rikai dekiru

だけど お触れに納得のいかない住民は
そんな兵士たちを敵視するようになった…

But the residents who aren't satisfied with the proclamation
have started looking at those soldiers with hostility...

<scale=0.97>The captain can offer them a regular supply of gruel, and an occasional trip to the Veil to help them forget the terrors they face each day. The duke offers them a vision of strength and safety.<scale>
dakedo o fureni nattoku noikanai juumin ha / sonna heishi tachiwo tekishi suruyouninatta…

いくら兵士がまとまったところで
住民と敵対してしまっては意味がないわ

No matter how united the soldiers are,
it's pointless if they end up at odds with the townspeople.

No. Any attempt to incite mutiny would cost Philippe the support of his men,
if it did not cost him his life.
ikura heishi gamatomattatokorode / juumin to tekitai shiteshimatteha imi ganaiwa

このままじゃ 壁の内側と外側の僻み合いどころか
住民と兵士の争いになってしまいそうで…

At this rate, it won't just be lingering bitterness between the inside and outside of the wall...
it's going to turn into a fight between the residents and the soldiers...
But given the mood around town, mutiny may yet be unavoidable. The people have little appetite for further deprivation, least of all when it serves only to elevate others.
konomamaja kabe no uchigawa to sotogawa no higami ai dokoroka / juumin to heishi no arasoi ninatteshimaisoude…
そんなことが…
To think...
And who could blame them.
sonnakotoga…
そうだ  もしかしたら――
Oh, that's right... maybe...
Clive...
souda moshikashitaraaa
クライヴの話なら  聞いてくれるかもしれない
He might listen if it's you talking, Clive.
Would you appeal to the duke on my behalf?
kuraivu no hanashi nara kii tekurerukamoshirenai

あなたは 青く光る魔物を倒して
兵士たちからも信頼されている

You defeated the glowing blue monster
and you have the soldiers' trust as well.

For your services to Northreach, you have the respect of the soldiers,
and they will take you to His Eminence if you ask them.
anataha aoku hikaru mamono wo taoshi te / heishi tachikaramo shinrai sareteiru

そんな相手の意見なら
彼も無下にはできないはずよ

If it's an opinion from someone like that,
he shouldn't just dismiss it.
And unlike Philippe, no bonds of loyalty prevent you from speaking your mind to the man.
sonna aite no iken nara / kare mo muge nihadekinaihazuyo

…クライヴ
オリフレム公と話し合ってもらえないかしら？

...Clive,
would you be willing to speak with the Duke of Oriflamme?
Well? Will you try? You could hardly fare any worse than I did.
… kuraivu / orifuremu kou to hanashiatsu temoraenaikashira？
ああ  俺でよければ力を貸そう
Right. If you'll have me, I'll lend a hand.
I'll see what I can do.
aa ore deyokereba chikara wo kaso u

よかった…
ありがとう クライヴ

Thank goodness...
Thank you, Clive.
Thank you, Clive.
yokatta… / arigatou kuraivu
まずは  オリフレム公に会う必要があるな
First, we need to meet with the Duke of Oriflamme.
Tell me, then—where will I find this Duke of Oriflamme?
mazuha orifuremu kou ni au hitsuyou gaaruna
彼は今どこに？
Where is he now?
In the garrison?
kareha ima dokoni？
訓練所にいると思うわ
I believe he's at the training grounds.
Overseeing the troops, yes.
kunrensho niiruto omou wa
分かった  行ってこよう
Understood. I'll head over.
Alright. Wish me luck.
waka tta itte koyou
そう…あなたならと思ったんだけど…
I see... I thought you might, but...
I understand. But if you should change your mind...
sou… anatanarato omotta ndakedo…
おい  止まれ
Hey, stop right there.
Halt.
oi toma re
何だ  マダムのところの用心棒じゃないか
Well, if it isn't the Dame's hired muscle.
Oh. Sorry about that. You're the Dame's man, aren't you?
nanda madamu notokorono youjinbou janaika
今日はどうしたんだい？
What brings you here today?
You got some business with the captain?
konnichiha doushitandai？
オリフレム公がここにいると聞いた
I heard the Duke of Oriflamme was here.
No, actually—with the duke.
orifuremu kou gakokoniiruto kii ta
彼に会わせてくれないか？
Can you let me see him?
I was hoping I might be able to speak with him.
kare ni awa setekurenaika？
今は住民を通すなと言われてるけど…
We've been told not to let any residents through right now, but...
We're under orders not to let any civilians pass...
ima ha juumin wo tousu nato iwa reterukedo…

きっとあんたなら問題ないだろう
この前 街を助けてくれた恩人だ

I'm sure it's fine if it's you.
You're the one who saved the city the other day.
But you should be alright. His Eminence has heard all about you and your heroics.
kittoantanara mondai naidarou / kono mae machi wo tasuke tekureta onjin da
少し待ってくれ
Wait here a minute.
Wait here. I'll go and ask.
sukoshi matsu tekure

――そうか 先日この街を救ってくれた
腕利きの傭兵とは貴様だったか
...So you were the skilled mercenary who saved this city the other day.
So you are the sellsword who lent his aid to the garrison. The empire owes you a debt.
-- souka senjitsu kono machi wo sukutsu tekureta / udekiki no youhei toha kisama dattaka
改めて礼を言うぞ
Allow me to thank you properly.
And I shall see it repaid.
aratame te rei wo iu zo
それで  私に何か用でも？
Now, what business do you have with me?
But tell me, is it wealth that you seek, or favor?
sorede watashi ni nanika you demo？
この街を  ザンブレクの新たな拠点にするそうだな
I hear you're making this city a new base for Sanbreque.

Neither, Your Eminence. I thought only to inquire about your plan
to turn Northreach into a stronghold.
kono machi wo zanbureku no arata na kyoten nisurusoudana
ああ  そのことかね
Ah, that matter.
Ah...I see.
aa sonokotokane
よその者に話すことでもないのだが…
It is not really something to discuss with an outsider, but...
You are worried the expanded garrison will render your services redundant.
yosono mono ni hanasu kotodemonainodaga…
貴様も  街の行く末が心配なのだろう
You, too, must be concerned for the city's future.
Yet you needn't be. A proud fighting man like yourself shall always have a place here.
kisama mo machi no yukusue ga shinpai nanodarou
だが  今後のことは我々に任せておけばよい
However, you need only leave matters concerning our future to us.

Pride of place, in fact. For too long has the contribution of
the noble soldier been underreckoned.
daga kongo nokotoha wareware ni makase teokebayoi
このノースリーチから  ザンブレクは“再建”されるのだ
Sanbreque shall be "rebuilt" starting from this Northreach.

But no more—for it is they who shall see the Holy Empire rebuilt,
beginning right here in Northreach.
kono noosuriichi kara zanbureku ha “ saiken ” sarerunoda
再建だって…？
Rebuilt...?
Why here, Your Eminence?
saiken datte…？

この街は被害も少なく 軍の設備もある
まさに再建のための拠点にふさわしい

This city suffered little damage and possesses military facilities.
It is truly fitting as a base for rebuilding.
The town has been fortunate enough to escape largely unscathed from the recent troubles. Her defenses are sound, and her garrison well-prepared.
kono machi ha higai mo sukunaku gun no setsubi moaru / masani saiken notameno kyoten nifusawashii
ザンブレクは  オリフレムに続いて自治領をも失った
Sanbreque has lost Oriflamme, and now the Dominion as well.
Which is more than can be said for Oriflamme or Twinside...
zanbureku ha orifuremu ni tsuzui te jichiryou womo utsu ta
皇都としての機能は  今や皆無と言ってよい
One might say its function as a royal capital is practically nonexistent now.
The empire wants for a capital, and I believe Northreach to be the perfect place.
kouto toshiteno kinou ha imaya kaimu to itte yoi

そこで この街を新たな拠点とし
ほど近いノルヴァーン砦を要塞とする

Thus, we shall make this city our new base
and fortify nearby Norvent Fortress.

With Caer Norvent as her citadel. Once we have seen to the refortification of
both the town and the castle...
sokode kono machi wo arata na kyoten toshi / hodo chikai noruvaan toride wo yousai tosuru
この一帯に  堅牢な城塞都市を築くつもりだ
We intend to build a stout walled city across this entire region.
...we need only build a wall around both to create a city that would be the envy of the Twins.
kono ittai ni kenrou na jousai toshi wo kizuku tsumorida
我々が  この街を守る
We will protect this city.
Plans are already underway for the construction.
wareware ga kono machi wo mamoru
話に聞く青く光る魔物とて  もはや敵ではなかろう
Even that blue-glowing monster you hear of can hardly be a threat to us anymore.
Soon enough, these "thralls" shall learn that they are no match for the might of Sanbreque.
hanashi ni kiku aoku hikaru mamono tote mohaya teki dehanakarou

あの魔物は危険だ
いつ襲われるかも分からない

That monster is dangerous.
There's no telling when it might strike.
I fear you underestimate how dangerous these creatures are, Your Eminence.
ano mamono ha kiken da / itsu osowa rerukamo waka ranai

あんたは 住民の財産を徴収しようとしているそうだが
そんなことはやめて 彼らと協力して対処にあたるべきだ

I hear you're planning to confiscate the residents' property.
You should put a stop to that and work together with them to handle this.

<scale=0.93>Should they return in force, you will need all the people of Northreach to come together in defense of the town—something they may be loath to do if they've been deprived of their worldly goods.<scale>
antaha juumin no zaisan wo choushuu shiyoutoshiteirusoudaga / sonnakotohayamete karera to kyouryoku shite taisho niatarubekida
民というのは  誰かが導いてやらねば動けんよ
The populace cannot act unless someone guides them.
The people will do as their leaders command.
tami toiunoha dareka ga michibii teyaraneba ugoke nyo
すなわち  国を立て直すために優先すべきはその中枢
That is to say, what must be prioritized to set the nation back on its feet is its core.
If Sanbreque is to be rebuilt, she will require a functioning government.
sunawachi kuni wo tatenaosu tameni yuusen subekihasono chuusuu
何よりも先に  行政を整備せねば
Before anything else, we must organize the administration.
One whose authority is beyond question.
nani yorimo sakini gyousei wo seibi seneba
彼らの財産は  そのために使わせてもらう
Their property will be put toward that end.
That is why this levy is necessary.
karera no zaisan ha sonotameni tsukawa setemorau

何も搾取するばかりではない
国に仕えるなら給金を出すとも伝えた

It is not merely exploitation.
I have also informed them that wages will be paid to those who serve the state.

So that any man who wishes to join the army might do so, and be fed, outfitted,
and paid as befits a defender of the empire.
nanimo sakushu surubakaridehanai / kuni ni tsukae runara kyuukin wo dasu tomo tsutae ta

それなのに 私が無茶な要求をして追い出したがっていると
住民を扇動する輩もいるようだが…
And yet, it seems there are those who incite the residents, claiming I am making unreasonable demands and trying to drive them out...
